chapter_title_en: The Walls of the War God Hall
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 229 – War God Hall Difficulty, Star Hall Enlightenment & Nine Lotos' Departure
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns the true difficulty of the War God Hall's third level. The artifact spirits explain the chasm between minor Daos, Grand Daos, and Heavenly Daos. Ji Ning enters a profound enlightenment in the Star Hall, mastering the Windwing Evasion. Meanwhile, Nine Lotos sets out for Yan Mountain.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 229 – The War God Hall's Brutal Truth & Star Hall Enlightenment
og_description: Ji Ning discovers even Celestial Immortal Juhua struggled with the War God Hall's trials. The artifact spirits drop ancient lore on Dao hierarchy, and Ji Ning's Star Hall breakthrough shocks even them. Nine Lotos heads to Winged Serpent Lake.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 229 – The War God Hall's Secret
twitter_description: Ji Ning is told he has less than a 1 in 10 chance of clearing the War God Hall's third level. The artifact spirits reveal the chasm between minor Daos and Grand Daos. Plus, Nine Lotos sets out to find him!

lore_anchors.definition: The aquatic estate's trial hierarchy; levels 1-2 test Zifu-level Fiendgod Body Refiners, while levels 3-4 require Wanxiang-level physical cultivation.
A vast, interconnected domain of cosmic law (e.g., Sword Dao, Dao of Spacetime). Far harder to master than a minor Dao; even Celestial Immortal Juhua never fully mastered one.
A single, narrow phenomenon or aspect of cosmic law (e.g., Dao of Wind, Dao of Fire). Multiple minor Daos can be comprehended, but they are inferior to a single Grand Dao.
A universal law that underpins an entire chaosworld; the highest tier of Dao. Daoist Threelives never mastered one.
The Primordial Fiendgod who built the aquatic estate; born with innate mastery of a Grand Dao; never mastered a Heavenly Dao.
The former master of the aquatic estate; a renowned Sword Immortal who mastered nine minor Daos but never a Grand Dao.
The enlightenment sanctuary of the aquatic estate; contains the mysteries of the Dao in its stars, landscapes, and even the rustling leaves. Reading the Star Scroll here triggers deep enlightenment.
A movement divine ability of the Yuchi clan; at its true form, the user merges with the wind and moves with Roc-like speed.
A senior apprentice-sister of Ji Ning's at the Black-White College; a Wanxiang Adept who learns Ji Ning's location and decides to travel to Winged Serpent Lake.
Ji Ning's chosen home in the Yan Mountains where he plans to settle long-term.
